#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P)
release_arg=${1-}

if [ -z "$release_arg" ] || [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s RELEASE_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi

if [ ! -d "$release_arg" ]; then
    printf 'publish: release directory not found: %s\n' "$release_arg" >&2
    exit 1
fi

release=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$release_arg" && pwd -P)
if [ ! -f "$release/MANIFEST" ]; then
    printf 'publish: refusing release without MANIFEST: %s\n' "$release_arg" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tmp="$base/.current.new.$$"
trap 'rm -f -- "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
ln -s -- "$release" "$tmp"
# Both names are in the same directory, so rename(2) replaces current atomically.
mv -Tf -- "$tmp" "$base/current"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM

command:
set -u
base=/srv/legacy2/atomic-release-publication
cd "$base" || exit 1
sentinel=/tmp/atomic-publish-running.$$
summary=/tmp/atomic-publish-reader.$$
fail=/tmp/atomic-publish-fail.$$
: > "$sentinel"
(
    reads=0
    saw_one=0
    saw_two=0
    while [ -e "$sentinel" ]; do
        target=$(readlink current) || { printf 'current absent\n' > "$fail"; exit 1; }
        resolved=$(readlink -f current) || { printf 'current unresolved: %s\n' "$target" > "$fail"; exit 1; }
        [ -f current/MANIFEST ] || { printf 'MANIFEST absent via current: %s\n' "$target" > "$fail"; exit 1; }
        [ -f "$resolved/MANIFEST" ] || { printf 'target MANIFEST absent: %s\n' "$resolved" > "$fail"; exit 1; }
        manifest=$(cat "$resolved/MANIFEST") || { printf 'MANIFEST unreadable: %s\n' "$resolved" > "$fail"; exit 1; }
        content=$(cat "$resolved/index.txt") || { printf 'index unreadable: %s\n' "$resolved" > "$fail"; exit 1; }
        case "$manifest|$content" in
            'release=one|Complete release one.') saw_one=$((saw_one + 1)) ;;
            'release=two|Complete release two.') saw_two=$((saw_two + 1)) ;;
            *) printf 'incomplete/mixed target=%s manifest=%s content=%s\n' "$resolved" "$manifest" "$content" > "$fail"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        reads=$((reads + 1))
    done
    printf 'reads=%s saw_one=%s saw_two=%s\n' "$reads" "$saw_one" "$saw_two" > "$summary"
) &
reader_pid=$!
writer_rc=0
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 200 ]; do
    if [ $((i % 2)) -eq 1 ]; then rel=releases/two; else rel=releases/one; fi
    bin/publish "$rel" || { writer_rc=1; break; }
    sleep 0.005
    i=$((i + 1))
done
rm -f "$sentinel"
wait "$reader_pid"
reader_rc=$?
printf 'writer_exit=%s transitions=%s reader_exit=%s %s\n' "$writer_rc" "$((i - 1))" "$reader_rc" "$(cat "$summary" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -f "$fail" ]; then cat "$fail"; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- explicit publish two ---'
bin/publish releases/two
printf 'target=%s manifest=%s content=%s\n' "$(readlink current)" "$(cat current/MANIFEST)" "$(cat current/index.txt)"
printf '%s\n' '--- rollback one ---'
bin/publish releases/one
printf 'target=%s manifest=%s content=%s\n' "$(readlink current)" "$(cat current/MANIFEST)" "$(cat current/index.txt)"
printf '%s\n' '--- staged-release checksums ---'
sha256sum releases/one/MANIFEST releases/one/index.txt releases/two/MANIFEST releases/two/index.txt
rm -f "$summary" "$fail"
[ "$writer_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$reader_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$i" -eq 201 ]
